deployment.comparison_scope: New contemporaneous legacy/compact ABBA on same authorized GPU, every warmup+cell within one shared lock. Prior diagnostic is motivation only.

plan.stop_rule: Exactly this ABBA; no GC thresholds/policy changes, repeated budget search, or automatic followup repeat. If compact fails to reduce retention pauses/full-gap cost, stop this storage change. Never remove old pause costs.

intervention.legacy: Original request_measurement unchanged, retains output event dicts and new-token lists.
intervention.compact: Append primitive invalid tuple before original validation, replace with validated tuple after it; reconstruct event dicts and token slices after original end=now(). No changed arrival/output timestamp, prefix validation, native path, or GC setting.

plan.correctness_scope: Targeted fake-engine original/compact full-field equivalence including malformed prefix, length, multiple-token chunks and engine error; exact-source/CLI adapters. Retain existing runtime resource, termination, lock and workload checks.
plan.source_basis: Frozen passive GC once runner and original request_measurement; compact_capture exact source adapter changes only event retention, reconstructs all JSON fields after original end timestamp.
plan.primary_readout: Per-run gen2 callback interval union/max and complete request maximum-gap distribution; full TTFT/flow/throughput/fixed exploratory SLO. Report post-observation materialization time, phase times, all failures and output/copy work.

gc_observation.clock: time.perf_counter host clock; align against raw measurement origin/end without altering raw timestamps
gc_observation.retained_events: All generation-2 collections and paired events lasting at least 0.001 seconds; this is logging detail, not a scheduling threshold.
gc_observation.short_event_accounting: per_generation aggregates cover the entire installation window; short events without individual timestamps cannot be exactly cropped to the raw measurement interval.
gc_observation.lifecycle: Record installation/uninstallation host time, GC enablement and thresholds; pair start/stop callbacks, retain pairing anomalies and pending_at_uninstall.
gc_observation.causal_limit: GC overlap plus randomized-free fixed ABBA representation intervention can test this storage source; other objects/host/GPU work remain. No proof about older runs or pure CPU pause cost.
